item.title: Inside Netanyahu's key White House meeting with Trump
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu expressed doubt about a deal with Iran during his meeting with President Trump and discussed other issues.

item.title: How AI complicates the work of central banks
item.description: Central bankers aim for stable prices, strong employment, and financial stability. The AI boom adds complexity to all three goals.

item.title: White House pushes Senate GOP for pre-election megabill
item.description: White House officials plan to urge Senate Republicans on Wednesday to approve a blueprint for another GOP-only megabill before the election.

item.title: Fed holds rates steady amid internal dissent
item.description: The Federal Reserve kept its interest rate target unchanged on Wednesday, despite significant internal disagreement from officials who favored a rate hike.
